motion_language.choice: ONE monotone cubic (Fritsch-Carlson) spline over explicit (frame,value) knots, sampled per frame, for every transform in every beat. Entrance and drift are the SAME knot list - never an ease-in followed by an ambient loop. Banned by construction: cubic-bezier, easeInOut/expo/back formulas, spring(), CSS transitions. The |m| <= 3*secant clamp means the only way an element moves is a knot list, and the only way it overshoots is an explicit apex knot.

BASE = 12f (0.400s) @30fps. Closed ladder, no other frame counts allowed: micro write-on 6f / chip-label-small plate 12f / plate-card-tile 16f / hero mark-number 20f / bar-counter value clock 40f / shine 13f (9f when duration < 45f) / halo breath 10f (6f when duration < 45f) / group stagger 4f (3f when the group has 4+ members) / micro-stagger 1f between the parts of ONE element (max 4 parts).

By element class, one number each: micro (rules, ticks, hairlines) 0px - write-on only; chip 42px rise; plate/card/tile 32px rise; hero mark/number 30px rise; lateral |x| <= 24px for any element narrower than 880px, 0px for anything full-width (>=880px at x=80 cannot drift in x and stay inside 80..1000). Direction: entrances come from BELOW (+y) or <=16px from a side. Never from above, never from off-frame. ONE named exception per piece: the throw (u10-stub, 516px lateral) - allowed only with an arc knot (y -15px at the apex), a >2% scale dip mid-flight and its own SFX.

Exactly ONE interior apex per property (the entrance apex), and at most ONE additional story extremum (u10 tension dip, u11 refusal flinch), which may not occur after 0.80 x duration. Magnitudes: <=2% scale, <=8px position, <=8deg rotation (rotation allowed ONLY on the two status stamps: u11 stamp, u13 seal). Zero overshoot on numbers, bars, money, cards, logos. The apex is an explicit knot, never a formula, and NO property may end its last segment on an apex - the tangent into the cut must be non-zero, always.

Group stagger 4f top-to-bottom; 3f when the group has 4 or more siblings, so the group's reveal never exceeds 22f (0.73s). Micro-stagger 1f between the parts of one element (dot, title, bars). Those three numbers are the whole rhythm vocabulary: any beat using 5f, 6f or 7f stagger is out of language.

The last NEW event of a beat - an entrance, a state change, a shine, a value lock - must BEGIN no later than (duration - tail) with tail = max(8 frames, 0.15 x duration). After it, nothing new; every transform keeps drifting at a non-zero rate through the tail. A locked NUMBER is legal (a value may hold); a locked TRANSFORM is not.

Drift is a RATE, not a total: hero layer +0.40px/f x, -0.33px/f y, +0.0015 scale/f (~12px/s, -10px/s); support 0.6x; ambient 0.3x. All layers move in the SAME direction (parallax), never opposite. Floor 0.20px/f - below that a beat reads as frozen (this is what kills the current u13); ceiling 0.60px/f. At any instant exactly ONE element per beat may exceed 0.50px/f, and it must be the hero's own gesture or its shine.

At most two soft light events per beat, exactly ONE of them travelling. (1) The shine: one white band (alpha 0.95), masked to the object's OWN alpha (acts on ink, silhouette never moves), left-to-right, 13f (9f compressed), band FWHM 140px (110px compressed), near-linear with a 2-frame ease-out, starting once the hero has settled (>=4f after the cut on beats < 45f, >=7f otherwise). Never on gold, never on cream, never as an overlay outside the mask. (2) 4-6f after it ends, a UNIFORM halo breath (10f, +0.10 alpha lift, +0.006 scale, no travel). No second sweep, no loop, no coloured glow, no card sheen.

Dry cut only between beats. No wipe, no slide, no crossfade between palcos, no camera punch, no film-like dissolve. The ONLY crossfade in the piece is the state change (cream sheet -> ink block) on a single plate: 9f, u01 f34-f42 and u12 f28-f37, with the TYPE swapping on one frame inside it.

Two surfaces, no third. S1 sheet = cream #F4EFE6 fill + 1px rgba(28,26,24,0.14) hairline + plateShadow (0 10px 22px rgba(28,26,24,0.10)) - the default for every card, chip, tile and container on both stages. S2 block = ink #1C1A18 fill + plateLift (0 18px 38px rgba(28,26,24,0.16)) + cream type - exactly ONE per beat, and it is always the winner/hero surface. Outline = transparent + 1.5px hairline (slots, lanes, tracks). WHITE PLATES ARE BANNED on palco B and palco C; white is a type colour on ink only. Empty-slot fills are rgba(28,26,24,0.16) - never 0.08, which is only 1.28:1 on cream and disappears on a phone.

ONE gold OBJECT per beat, and it always means the decision/winner. Gold is legal only ON INK: (a) a filled shape carrying ink type, (b) type on an ink plate, (c) a 2-6px rule or underline sitting <=12px directly under an ink label. Gold on cream (1.61:1) or gold on a 16% track (1.18:1) is invisible and is a bug, so every gold fill must live inside an ink surface (ink pill, ink card, ink rail). A handoff - gold draining off one object while another receives it - is allowed with <=3 frames of overlap (u11: the value drains f46-f51 as the stamp arrives f49).

Frozen; no beat may invent a size. heroNumber 232 / bigNumber 132 (u11 -40%) / heroLabel 72 / cardTitle 56 / chipValue 52 / chipLabel 34 / smallCaps 24 with +0.14em tracking (the ONLY letterspaced role) / accent 62 (Alvito, one word, ASCII-only) / unit 88 / logoCaption 30 / microLabel 20 (absolute floor). Every number that changes value renders in NumericSlots: fixed 0.70em slots, glyph centred, because Hetrixo has no GSUB/tnum and '1' is 0.325em against '0' at 0.667em - natural advance crawls 2.05x sideways.
Linear, always, and only over the first 6f of a chip/label or 8f of a plate; clamped 0..1; never splined, never drifting. An element's fade completes and the transform carries the life from then on.

One camera wrapper per beat, one monotone spline, moving the whole graphic layer at the drift rate. Used only where the beat is long enough to need it (u13: x +0.30px/f, y -0.21px/f = a 57px push over 190f). No punch, no per-beat zoom, no frame rotation. Depth = three layers at 1.0 / 0.6 / 0.3 of the drift rate, all in the same direction. Any element of width >=880px has an x drift of 0.

An element whose transform does not change for 2+ consecutive frames after its entrance, or whose velocity is 0 on the cut frame, is a defect - not a style choice. The spline must carry a non-zero tangent into the last frame of every beat. Additionally, no palco B beat may open on an empty frame: the first element's entrance began before the cut, so at f0 it is at s >= 0.55 and alpha >= 0.4 (implement as start = -5 on the first element).

Palco B: opaque content only in x 80..1000 / y 40..700; author every resting bottom <= 664 and keep every shadow/blur's outer edge <= 700; alpha 0 for every pixel below y=960 at EVERY frame including entry, apex and drift. Palco C: cream #F4EFE6 opaque full frame, all content y 80..1400, band y 1500..1750 quiet, nothing opaque below 1750. Eyebrow cap-top: palco B 96 (box top 92.6), palco C 124 (box top 120.6). Left edge of every text block: x=80 on BOTH stages, so a B->C->B cut never shifts the type.

shared_primitives.behavior: Exists in src/kit/curve.ts, keep verbatim. Sorts knots, builds secant tangents as the mean of adjacent secants, clamps |m|<=3*d within each interval, samples Hermite per frame. This IS the easing family - no other interpolation function may appear in a beat.
shared_primitives.name: curve

shared_primitives.behavior: Exists, keep. Prepends a 2-frame step covering 12% of the travel so the move starts from rest instead of from a cable. Only legal use: the first knot pair of an entrance that must start dead still; entrances that cut into motion (start=-5) skip it.
shared_primitives.name: settle

shared_primitives.api: progress(frame, {start=-5, enter=12, duration, ease:'enter'|'rise'|'pop'}): {s, tail, settled}
shared_primitives.behavior: REWRITE the 'pop' branch: it currently calls easeOutBack (1.70158*0.42), a formula outside the spline family. pop must become apex knots through the same curve(): [[0,0],[enter*0.6,0.90],[enter,1.02],[enter+6,1]]. 'enter' stays [[0,0],[enter*0.55,0.84],[enter,1]]; 'rise' stays [[0,0],[enter*0.5,0.62],[enter,1]]. tail stays one monotone spline from dStart=start+enter/2 to duration with knots [[dStart,0],[dStart+0.4L,0.28],[dEnd,1]] - its last secant is non-zero, which is what guarantees no velocity zero at the cut. Accepts start<0 (the cut-into-motion rule).
shared_primitives.name: progress

shared_primitives.api: resolve(frame, to:{x,y,scale,rotate}, from:{...}, {start, enter, ease, duration, driftRate:{x,y,scale}}): {x,y,scale,rotate,opacity,tail}
shared_primitives.behavior: CHANGE the drift from a total to a RATE: offset = driftRate * ((duration - frame)/30) seconds. A beat therefore declares px/second and every beat keeps the same physical speed regardless of length (the current token drift {x:6,y:-5} is a total, which is why a 57f beat moves at 0.10px/f and a 190f beat at 0.03px/f - both frozen). Sums from the same tail clock as the entrance, so the position never stops. Opacity is clamped and never drifts: opacity = clamp(lerp(from,to,s)) or explicit linear knots.
shared_primitives.name: resolve

shared_primitives.api: <Enter frame duration enter start from={{y:42,scale:0.97,opacity:0}} driftRate={MOTION.driftHero|driftSupport|driftAmbient} ease>children</Enter>
shared_primitives.behavior: The wrapper that applies resolve(). Every positioned element in every beat goes through it - a beat that hand-rolls a transform string is out of language. Default start = -5 for the beat's FIRST element, 0 for the rest.
shared_primitives.name: Enter

shared_primitives.api: NumericSlots({text, size, slot=0.70, color, edge:'right'|'center', style})
shared_primitives.behavior: MANDATORY for every changing value (u01 percentages, u08 94%, u11 -40%, u13 5 and 18, u14 0,50). Each glyph gets its own fixed 0.70em box, the glyph optically centred inside it; the comma takes a 0.35em box. Right-edge anchoring so a rising value grows leftward without moving its column. This is the single highest-risk bug in the piece: Hetrixo has no tnum, so natural advance makes a 1-digit to 2-digit transition change the block's width by 2.05x.
shared_primitives.name: NumericSlots

shared_primitives.api: useValue(frame, knots: Point[]): number  +  barPct(value, max): number
shared_primitives.behavior: Samples the value's OWN knot list with the same curve() - the counter's clock is independent of the wrapper's transform clock. Bar width is derived from the same number (one driver) so the number and the fill can never disagree.
shared_primitives.name: useValue

shared_primitives.api: BrandMark({brand:'jev'|'chatgpt'|'claude'|'grok', box, height?, tone='ink'|'cream'|'gold'|'muted', shine?, pad?, style})
shared_primitives.behavior: Draws the PNG TINTED FLAT: a div whose background is the tone, masked by the PNG's own alpha (WebkitMaskImage/maskImage = url(brand)), so teal #74AA9C and coral #D97757 never reach the frame. The same mask clips the shine child. pad insets a full-bleed mark so its rays are not cropped (claude needs 1.4x its apparent size, grok 0.90 aspect, chatgpt's squircle is full-bleed with a sharp bottom-right corner). Replaces the raw in ui.tsx.
shared_primitives.name: BrandMark

shared_primitives.behavior: The travelling band only (t = sweep(frame, start, 13)), drawn inside a caller-owned mask/clip so it can never paint outside the object. White only - the gold stop currently in u04 must be deleted. Outside t in [0,1] it renders nothing (no residue in the next frame).
shared_primitives.name: Shine

shared_primitives.behavior: The uniform post-shine event: a single apex, +0.10 alpha and +0.006 scale on the object's own masked ink, no travel. This replaces u05's second shine sweep and u04's ring-as-second-event.
shared_primitives.name: Breath

shared_primitives.api: <Ring t d0 d1 alpha0=0.55 alpha1=0.15 stroke=2 color=gold />
shared_primitives.behavior: Concentric emit for u04 only: diameter on a monotone spline from d0 to d1, alpha draining linearly, stroke gold on the ink disc (9.4:1). It is the ambient layer - it may never exceed the drift ceiling's spirit (cap the final D so its bottom stays <= 664).
shared_primitives.name: Ring

shared_primitives.api: <Bar pct w h radius trackTone='cream'|'ink' fill />
shared_primitives.behavior: Exists; change the track default to rgba(28,26,24,0.16) and add rgba(244,239,230,0.16) for the ink surface. A gold fill is legal ONLY with trackTone='ink' (gold on a cream track is 1.18:1).
shared_primitives.name: Bar

shared_primitives.behavior: Exists; DELETE 'white' from the tone union so a white plate cannot compile. cream = S1 sheet (cream fill + 1px rgba(28,26,24,0.14) + plateShadow), ink = S2 block (ink fill + plateLift, no border), outline = transparent + 1.5px hairline. This is the palette lock enforced by the type system instead of by discipline.
shared_primitives.name: Plate

shared_primitives.api: <Chip label value tone='sheet'|'block' meter={{pct, fill:'ink'|'gold'|'muted'}} w=920 h=96 />
shared_primitives.behavior: The decision row (u01, u07): 920x96, radius 26, label chipLabel 34 at x=116, value chipValue 52 right-aligned to x=964, meter an 8px bar flush inside the bottom edge (clipped by the radius). sheet = cream + hairline + muted; block = ink + cream type + gold meter. The winner is expressed by tone, not by an extra ring.
shared_primitives.name: Chip

shared_primitives.api: <Card tone='sheet'|'block' w=920 h header body footer />
shared_primitives.behavior: The container for u09/u10/u11 and the base of u08. DELETE the sheen prop - a white sweep on a light plate is invisible and a 5th event. u09/u10/u11 = sheet; u08 = block. Same internal padding (34/36) across the three cards so the swap reads as the same object.
shared_primitives.name: Card

shared_primitives.behavior: Write-on hairline: scaleX 0->1, origin left, 6f, one apex +2%, colour rgba(28,26,24,0.14). Micro class - no translation ever. Used by every header rule, dropline, divider and rail in the piece.
shared_primitives.name: Rule

shared_primitives.behavior: Exists; add an explicit offset override and set offset=3 when count>=4. A beat may never pass a literal stagger of 5, 6 or 7.
shared_primitives.name: staggerStart

shared_primitives.behavior: Dev invariant check run on every beat: throws if a resting bottom > 664 (B) or > 1400 (C), if an element whose width >= 880 declares a non-zero x drift, if a shadow's outer edge crosses 700 (B), or if a property's final two knots are not strictly monotone. Makes the language a compile/run-time failure instead of a review note.
shared_primitives.name: stageGuard

shared_primitives.api: MOTION = {base:12, enter:12, enterPlate:16, enterHero:20, enterBig:20, micro:6, shine:13, shineShort:9, breath:10, stagger:4, stagger4:3, microStagger:1, apex:{scale:0.02, px:8, rot:8}, driftHero:{x:12,y:-10,scale:0.0015}, driftSupport:0.6x, driftAmbient:0.3x, travel:{micro:0,chip:42,plate:32,hero:30,lateral:24}, tail:(d)=>Math.max(8,0.15*d)}
shared_primitives.behavior: The current tokens are the source of the inconsistency: drift {x:6,y:-5,scale:0.006} is a frozen TOTAL, travel:26 collapses three element classes into one, and enterHero:18 / enterBig:24 are off the recon's 12/16/20 ladder. Replace wholesale. Beats read tokens only - no beat may hold a motion number of its own.
shared_primitives.name: tokens

per_beat_fixes.fix: 1) SURFACE: hero chip_01 is an S1 cream sheet until f34, then a 9f state crossfade (f34-f42) to the S2 ink block, the type swapping on one frame; chips 02/03 stay S1 sheets with muted label, muted value and a muted meter. The three white 920x164 cards are the exact defect the brief exists to fix (white on cream = 1.15:1) and are deleted. 2) GEOMETRY: rows 920x96 r26 at y=236/352/468 (gap 20, resting bottom 564 <= 664), replacing 920x164 at 120/308/496; label chipLabel 34 at x=116, value chipValue 52 in NumericSlots right-aligned to x=964, meter 8px flush at the chip's bottom edge. The hero's 84px value and the losers' 64px values are both off-scale (locked: 52). 3) ENTRANCE: +64px from ABOVE is double the chip budget and the wrong direction - use from={{y:42, scale:0.97}}, enter 12f, one apex +6px at f12, monotone settle; opacity linear over 6f and chip_01 starts at -5 so f0 is not empty. 4) APEXES: kill the y list [(0,-64),(10,+7),(15,-3),(56,+7)] - it has three extrema and the last one lands ON THE CUT, so Fritsch-Carlson clamps the tangent to zero on the final frame: that is the banned 'entrou e parou' sitting in beat 1. Use [[0,42],[12,-6],[20,-2],[56,+4]] with x drift 0 (a 920-wide chip cannot move in x). 5) RING: delete. A 3px gold stroke on a cream chip is 1.61:1 and a second gold object. 6) SHEEN: delete. A white band at 28% travelling 20px/f over the gold fill is a fourth event and breaks 'one element above 0.50px/f'. 7) STAGGER 5f -> 4f (chips at -5/+4/+8). 8) SFX: keep the snap at f12 (the hero's apex) and the click at f34 (the lock); DELETE the riser at f12 - a snap and a riser on the same frame is one event scored twice. 9) The meter fills INK while the chip is cream and turns GOLD exactly at the state change, so gold appears once and means 'decided'.
